notes: Modified cash basis city, FY ended 2024-09-30. Governmental beginning/ending cash are the governmental funds fund balances (deficit) (p6): -176,778 to -377,503; the Reclassifications line nets to zero in the total column. Debt principal 180,000 and interest 58,885 are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) on p6, below Total expenditures, so they are disbursements with outside_printed_total. Taxes 448,342 (p5) split by fund column using the fund schedules: General, Street and Debt Service property taxes (p12, p14, p16) and Sales Tax Fund local sales tax (p17); the Cemetery, Swimming Pool and Library Fund columns are printed only as 'Taxes' and stay taxes (unlabeled). Intergovernmental 240,529 (p5) split using the General, Street, Debt Service and Sales Tax fund schedules (p12, p14, p16, p17), which tie exactly. Business-type: the modified cash proprietary statement (p8) is used; Loan proceeds 206,965 -> business_type.debt_proceeds, transfers 2,375 -> transfers_net; roll-forward 847,875 + 490,128 - 631,074 + 2,375 + 206,965 = 916,269. The p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position (report p31, accrual with depreciation, net position 1,482,995) and the p10 Statement of Cash Flows are on a different basis and are not used. Detail: the all-funds budgetary statement (p11) is not recorded because each major fund has its own budget schedule (pp12-22); nonmajor funds from the combining statement (p23). Budget lines with no actual amount (General 'Payroll tax and other reimbursements', General transfers from other funds, Sales Tax bond proceeds, Cemetery transfers, Sewer payroll taxes) are not recorded. Balance sheet (user rule 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, totals equal the government-wide governmental column); business-type lines and totals from the Statement of Net Position (p1).
